notablePrerequisites: Hex Parasite does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hex Parasite, adding {C}{C}.
Hex Parasite dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Initiates of the Ebon Hand by paying {1}, adding {B}.
Activate Hex Parasite by paying {1}{B}, removing the +1/+1 counter from it and giving it +1/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.
